watch.summary: The streamer aggressively hypes and roasts an opposing Valorant team while watching match replays.

beats.what: Creator watches match footage while explaining his team's strategy.
Creator mocks the opponent Neon player's fast movement as they get eliminated.
Creator laughs and shouts about the enemy team calling a timeout that didn't help them.
Creator continues hyping up the play as his team stays dominant.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: They took a time out, thought it was gonna work out, absolutely not!
watch.why: The clip relies on esports watch-party hype rather than traditional comedy beats. The energy comes from the streamer's expressive roasting of the opponent's failed tactical timeout.
